helpStep1ChooseTradeDesc: Select the required service trade, enter your house address, and pick your preferred time slot.
helpStep2SelectWorkerDesc: Choose from recommended nearby cooperative members based on ratings and completed jobs.

helpMgrFaq1Q: How do I resolve on-site worker disputes before statutory escalation?
helpMgrFaq1A: Zonal Managers can act as conciliation mediators for minor disputes. If the issue involves non-payment or safety violations, it must be referred to the official Labor Department Officer docket.
helpMgrFaq2Q: How are zonal welfare funds disbursed to workers?
helpMgrFaq2A: Welfare disbursements (medical advance, tool grants) are approved jointly by the Zonal Manager and Federation Admin based on verified tenure and contribution history.
helpOfficerModDashDesc: Statutory bench for reviewing filed worker and household disputes, inspecting evidence, and issuing binding rulings.
helpOfficerModDashStep2: Click on any Case ID to open the detailed Evidence & Adjudication Inspector.
helpOfficerModDashStep3: Inspect the claimant statement, uploaded documents/photos, linked Geo-Dispatch logs, and job tariff details.
helpOfficerModCasesDesc: Comprehensive historical archive of labor conciliations, wage enforcement orders, and statutory settlements.

helpOfficerModCasesStep2: Review past recorded rulings and conciliation settlements.
helpOfficerModCasesStep3: Audit compliance with statutory fair wage thresholds and safety mandates.
helpOfficerModRulingDesc: Step-by-step procedure for recording statutory dispute resolutions and releasing escrow funds.
helpOfficerModRulingStep1: Step 1 (Evidence Audit): Inspect timestamped chats, site photos, and completion logs.
helpOfficerModRulingStep2: Step 2 (Record Hearing Notes): Enter official conciliation findings and legal rationale into the case record.
helpOfficerModRulingStep3: Step 3 (Select Outcome): Order full wage disbursement to worker, escrow refund to household, or split conciliation settlement.
helpOfficerModRulingStep4: Step 4 (Submit Ruling): Click "Record Official Ruling" to execute the judgment and notify all parties.
helpOfficerFaq1Q: Are rulings issued by the Labor Officer legally binding?
helpOfficerFaq1A: Yes. Under the cooperative dispute framework, decisions recorded by registered Labor Department Officers are binding on cooperative escrow settlements and platform standings.
helpOfficerFaq2Q: How does the system ensure evidence integrity?
helpOfficerFaq2A: All evidence attachments (photos, chat logs, bills) and Geo-Dispatch timestamps are cryptographically anchored to prevent tampering.
